title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 4,501–4,550 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 海洋學；海洋科技探勘

examples.en: Cutting-edge research vessels utilize satellite oceanography to map dynamic Kuroshio current eddies.
examples.zh: 頂尖海洋研究船運用高階衛星海洋學測繪技術，精準分析黑潮暖流沿台灣東岸北上的動態渦流。

examples.en: She pursued a doctorate in chemical oceanography to study ocean acidification and carbon sequestration.
examples.zh: 她攻讀化學海洋學博士學位，專門投入海洋酸化機制與大洋深層碳封存潛力的前沿科學研究。

examples.en: Advances in robotic oceanography allow scientists to collect deep-sea temperature profiles year-round.
examples.zh: 自主水下機器人海洋探勘技術的突破，使科學家得以全天候終年不間斷監測深海海溫與鹽度剖面。

words.definition: 水肺潛水 (SCUBA)；水下自攜氣瓶

examples.en: Earning a PADI Open Water scuba certification unlocks breathtaking underwater coral kingdoms.
examples.zh: 考取國際 PADI 開放水域水肺潛水證照，能讓潛水員自由徜徉於五彩斑斕的夢幻水下珊瑚王國。

examples.en: Check your scuba cylinder pressure gauge regularly before descending into deeper ocean trenches.
examples.zh: 在向更深的海底大斷層下潛前，務必隨時低頭檢視隨身水肺氣瓶的殘壓表指針確認氣量。

examples.en: Scuba enthusiasts from around the world flock to Green Island for its pristine undersea volcanic formations.
examples.zh: 來自世界各地的水肺潛水狂熱者紛紛湧向綠島，親身探索清澈透亮的海底火山岩柱與大教堂景觀。

words.definition: 潛水呼吸調節器；調節閥

examples.en: The first-stage regulator reduces 200-bar high cylinder pressure into smooth, breathable air.
examples.zh: 專業一級頭調節器能將氣瓶內高達兩百巴的高壓壓縮空氣，精準調節為人體輕鬆呼吸的常壓氣流。

examples.en: Rinse your dive regulator thoroughly with fresh tap water after every salty ocean excursion.
examples.zh: 每次完成海水潛水上岸後，切記務必使用乾淨自來水徹底沖洗呼吸調節器上的殘留海鹽結晶。

examples.en: The technician inspected the secondary backup regulator to ensure it supplies effortless airflow in emergencies.
examples.zh: 專業裝備技師仔細檢測備用二級頭調節器（章魚頭），確保在深水緊急狀況下能瞬間順暢供氣。

words.definition: 浮力；水下中性浮力 (Neutral Buoyancy)

examples.en: Mastering neutral buoyancy allows divers to hover effortlessly without damaging fragile coral branches.
examples.zh: 熟練掌握完美的水下中性浮力，能讓潛水員如太空人般靜止懸浮於水中，完全不觸碰脆弱珊瑚。

examples.en: Inflating the buoyancy compensator vest brings you safely and smoothly back to the ocean surface.
examples.zh: 輕按充氣閥向浮力調整背心（BCD）微量充氣，能讓潛水員平穩省力地緩緩上升回到海面上。

examples.en: Fine adjustments using gentle lung breath control provide instantaneous trim and vertical buoyancy.
examples.zh: 透過肺部呼吸深淺吐納的細膩微調，能在水中達到瞬間精準的姿態平衡與垂直微浮力控制。

words.definition: 氯丁橡膠潛水防寒衣料；合成橡膠

examples.en: A 3mm thermal neoprene wetsuit keeps divers warm and protected in subtropical waters.
examples.zh: 穿著一件三毫米厚度的彈性氯丁橡膠潛水防寒衣，在亞熱帶海水中能提供絕佳保暖防寒與防刮防護。

examples.en: Flexible neoprene dive booties shield your feet from sharp volcanic basalt and spiky sea urchins.
examples.zh: 質地厚實耐磨的氯丁橡膠防滑潛水膠鞋，能完美保護腳掌免受鋒利火山玄武岩與尖銳海膽刺傷。

examples.en: Over time, prolonged sun exposure can cause natural synthetic neoprene to lose its elasticity.
examples.zh: 長期置於烈日高溫曝曬下，會使合成氯丁橡膠材質老化硬化，並逐漸失去原有的柔韌彈性。

words.definition: 潛水減壓；減壓病 (潛水夫病)

examples.en: Always conduct a 3-minute safety stop at 5 meters to prevent dangerous decompression sickness.
examples.zh: 上升回水面前務必在水深五米處進行三分鐘「安全停留」，讓體內氮氣安全排出以防減壓病。

examples.en: The modern dive computer calculates real-time no-decompression limits based on depth and bottom time.
examples.zh: 當代高階腕式潛水電腦錶能依據即時水深與水底停留時間，精準演算免減壓極限倒數計時。

examples.en: Severe decompression injury requires immediate evacuation to an onshore hyperbaric medical facility.
examples.zh: 嚴重的急性減壓病傷害，必須第一時間緊急後送至陸上醫學中心的專業高壓氧艙進行加壓救治。

words.definition: 浮潛呼吸管；浮潛

examples.en: Families rent masks and dry snorkels to observe colorful damselfish in shallow tidal pools.
examples.zh: 爸爸媽媽帶著小朋友租借全乾式呼吸管與面鏡，在清澈的淺灘潮池中興奮觀察游弋的雀鯛。

examples.en: Clear any trapped seawater from your snorkel with a single, sharp exhale of breath.
examples.zh: 當呼吸管管身不慎進水時，只需用力向上短促吐出一口氣，即可瞬間將積水經排水閥排除。

examples.en: Snorkel tours along the calm coast of Kenting are a wonderful introduction to ocean ecology for children.
examples.zh: 沿著墾丁避風海灣展開的休閒浮潛生態導覽，是帶領孩童親近認識浩瀚海洋生態的最佳啟蒙之窗。

words.definition: 潛水蛙鞋；魚鰭；鰭板

examples.en: Long carbon-fiber freediving fins deliver powerful thrust with minimal leg fatigue.
examples.zh: 換上一雙超長碳纖維自由潛水長蛙鞋，只需輕輕踢動雙腿即可在水下產生強勁的無聲推進力。

examples.en: Adjust the silicone heel straps of your open-heel fins snugly before stepping into the ocean surf.
examples.zh: 在邁步走進海浪碎浪區前，務必將套鞋式蛙鞋的矽膠後跟調整帶微調至服貼腳踝的緊度。

examples.en: The marine biologist identified the predatory shark species from the distinctive shape of its dorsal fin.
examples.zh: 海洋生物學家僅憑海面上露出的三角形背鰭輪廓與特殊弧度，便精準辨識出該鯊魚的具體品種。

words.definition: 珊瑚白化危機；漂白

examples.en: Elevated seawater temperatures caused by global warming trigger catastrophic coral bleaching events.
examples.zh: 全球暖化引發的夏季海水持續異常高溫，導致墾丁與澎湖海域爆發嚴重的珊瑚大規模白化危機。

examples.en: During intense bleaching, corals expel the symbiotic algae that provide them with vibrant colors and nutrients.
examples.zh: 在劇烈的海水高溫白化過程中，珊瑚蟲會被迫排出提供繽紛色彩與九成光合養分的共生藻。

examples.en: Marine conservation zones showed faster recovery from thermal bleaching compared to heavily fished reefs.
examples.zh: 與過度捕撈的衰退海域相比，管理良好的海洋保育區珊瑚礁在熱浪白化後的自我修復復原速度顯著更快。

words.definition: 海洋友善防曬乳；防曬霜

examples.en: National parks encourage tourists to switch to mineral reef-safe sunscreen to protect marine life.
examples.zh: 國家公園大力倡導遊客下海浮潛時換用不含二苯甲酮的物理性「海洋友善防曬乳」，守護珊瑚礁。

examples.en: Chemical ingredients like oxybenzone in conventional sunscreen disrupt larval coral development.
examples.zh: 傳統化學防曬乳中含有的二苯甲酮與辛氧酸酯成分，會嚴重阻礙珊瑚幼蟲的健康著床與骨骼發育。

examples.en: Generously apply non-nano zinc oxide sunscreen twenty minutes prior to outdoor beach exploration.
examples.zh: 在踏上海灘展開烈日戲水前二十分鐘，均勻塗抹足量的非奈米二氧化鈦物理防曬霜以保護肌膚。

words.definition: 綠蠵龜；海龜；陸龜

examples.en: Xiao Liuqiu is world-famous as a haven where hundreds of wild green sea turtles forage peacefully.
examples.zh: 屏東小琉球以清澈水質聞名全球，是數百隻野生保育類綠蠵龜在此悠閒覓食、棲息繁衍的海龜樂園。

examples.en: Volunteers patrol nesting beaches late at night to protect vulnerable baby turtles heading out to sea.
examples.zh: 海龜巡守志工每逢盛夏深夜在沙灘上耐心巡守，守護剛破殼而出的脆弱小海龜平安爬向大海。

examples.en: Regulations strictly prohibit divers from touching or chasing an endangered green sea turtle.
examples.zh: 國家野生動物保育法明文嚴禁任何潛水客追逐、觸摸或騷擾瀕危野生海龜，違者將面臨重罰。

words.definition: 鬼蝠魟；蝠魟 (Manta Ray)

examples.en: Graceful giant manta rays glide like oceanic birds, filtering plankton with wide cephalic fins.
examples.zh: 翼展超過五公尺的溫和巨大鬼蝠魟在水下如大鳥般優雅翱翔滑行，張開頭鰭溫柔濾食微小浮游生物。

examples.en: Encountering a resident manta ray cleaning station is on the bucket list of every globetrotting diver.
examples.zh: 在深海礁石旁親眼目睹鬼蝠魟排隊接受清潔蝦理療的「清潔站」奇觀，是每位國際潛水員的夢幻清單。

examples.en: Unlike stingrays, the harmless manta possesses no poisonous barb along its broad, muscular tail.
examples.zh: 與帶有劇毒尾刺的魟魚截然不同，個性溫馴善良的鬼蝠魟在細長的尾部末端完全沒有毒刺。

words.definition: 海洋浮游生物；微小浮游植物

examples.en: Microscopic marine plankton generates over half of the oxygen produced on planet Earth.
examples.zh: 漂浮在浩瀚大洋中的微小海洋浮游生物透過光合作用，供應了地球全人類呼吸所需的半數以上氧氣。

examples.en: Nocturnal plankton bioluminescence makes the breaking waves glow with ethereal turquoise fairy dust.
examples.zh: 夜間微小夜光蟲等浮游生物的受激發光，讓拍擊海岸的碎浪綻放出夢幻如藍眼淚般的青藍色星芒。

examples.en: Changes in ocean temperature directly alter the blooming schedules of primary producer phytoplankton.
examples.zh: 宏觀海洋表層水溫的些微劇變，會直接劇烈打亂海洋食物鏈最底層浮游植物的春季爆發時程。

words.definition: 互利共生；小丑魚與海葵共生

examples.en: The classic symbiosis between orange clownfish and stinging sea anemones protects both species.
examples.zh: 鮮亮橘色小丑魚與帶有劇毒觸手的海葵之間建立起著名的「互利共生」關係，彼此守護免受天敵威脅。

examples.en: Lichens thriving on coastal rocks represent an ancient mutualistic symbiosis between fungi and algae.
examples.zh: 緊密附著在海濱岩石上繁衍的原始地衣，展現了真菌菌絲與微小綠藻跨越億萬年的互利共生智慧。

examples.en: Exploring delicate ecological symbiosis reminds humans of our profound interconnectedness with natural systems.
examples.zh: 探索大自然中精雕細琢的生態共生體系，深層提醒著人類自身與萬物生靈休戚與共的依存連結。

words.definition: 海葵；海葵觸手

examples.en: Waving purple sea anemone tentacles provide a safe, immune home for territorial clownfish.
examples.zh: 隨波逐流輕柔搖曳的紫海葵觸手，為不怕其刺絲胞毒素的橘白相間小丑魚提供了最安全的家。

examples.en: Touching a sea anemone barehanded can trigger painful burning rashes due to venomous harpoon cells.
examples.zh: 徒手直接撫摸野生海葵可能引發劇烈灼痛紅腫，因為其觸手表面密布著極具殺傷力的刺絲胞毒素。

examples.en: The mouth of the carnivorous sea anemone sits at the central hub surrounded by undulating rings of tentacles.
examples.zh: 肉食性海葵的口器位於身體中央凹陷處，周圍被數圈如花瓣般不斷擺動捕食的柔軟觸手所環繞。

words.definition: 水下海蛞蝓（海中寶石）；裸鰓類

examples.en: Underwater photographers love spotting microscopic, brightly colored nudibranchs among sea sponges.
examples.zh: 水下微距攝影愛好者最熱衷在海綿與珊瑚縫隙間尋找色彩瑰麗如寶石般的微小海蛞蝓。

examples.en: Many nudibranch species absorb toxins from poisonous sponges and use them for personal chemical defense.
examples.zh: 許多品類的海蛞蝓能巧妙吸收有毒海綿中的化學毒素，化為自身抵禦掠食性魚類攻擊的強效防衛。

examples.en: The tiny nudibranch navigates the ocean seabed using specialized sensory antennas called rhinophores.
examples.zh: 這隻指甲蓋大小的繽紛海蛞蝓在海床上緩緩爬行，依靠頭部一對特化的嗅角感測周遭水流氣味。

words.definition: 水下沉船遺跡；沉船潛水；遭遇海難

examples.en: The historic steel shipwreck off Green Island became a thriving artificial reef home to thousands of fish.
examples.zh: 沉睡在綠島外海深處的鋼鐵沉船遺跡已蛻變為生機勃勃的人工魚礁，吸引成千上萬熱帶魚群聚集。

examples.en: Penetrating dark interior corridors inside an intact shipwreck requires advanced technical wreck training.
examples.zh: 想要穿越游入結構完好但漆黑幽閉的沉船內部艙道，必須受過嚴格的高階技術沉船潛水特訓。

examples.en: Marine archaeologists uncovered ancient ceramic cargo within the 300-year-old wooden merchant shipwreck.
examples.zh: 水下文化資產水下考古學家在一艘三百年前沉沒的古木造貿易商船遺址中，發掘出上萬件古董青花瓷。

words.definition: 水下外接閃光燈；頻閃燈

examples.en: Powerful dual underwater strobes restore vibrant natural crimson and yellow colors lost at depth.
examples.zh: 配備雙邊高瓦數專業水下閃光燈能瞬間還原深海中被水分子吸收殆盡的艷麗紅色與明亮黃色。

examples.en: Adjust the strobe arms outward to prevent floating particle backscatter from clouding your underwater photo.
examples.zh: 將水下閃燈支臂向兩側斜角展開，能巧妙避開水下懸浮浮游微粒反射強光造成的雜亂雪花回光。

examples.en: High-speed recycling strobes ensure underwater photographers capture lightning-fast predatory moments.
examples.zh: 具備超快回電速度的頂級水下閃光燈，能確保水下生態攝影大師精準定格掠食者電光石火的捕食瞬間。

words.definition: 水下能見度；清晰度 (玻璃水)

examples.en: Kenting's calm south coast boasts exceptional 30-meter visibility, creating crystal-clear water conditions.
examples.zh: 墾丁南灣與後壁湖在避風季節擁有高達三十公尺以上的超清能見度，宛如置身湛藍水晶玻璃水之中。

examples.en: Heavy monsoon rains and agricultural runoff often reduce inshore diving visibility down to five meters.
examples.zh: 盛夏強烈的西南氣流豪雨與泥沙沖刷入海，往往會讓近岸潛點的水下能見度驟降至五米以內。

examples.en: Divers maintain buddy contact by keeping close proximity when horizontal visibility drops in murky harbors.
examples.zh: 當混濁港灣內的水下水平能見度驟降時，潛水同伴間必須縮短彼此間距，始終保持肢體可及的戒護。

words.definition: 洋流；海流；當前的

examples.en: Skilled scuba divers ride strong ocean currents during thrilling deep drift dives.
examples.zh: 經驗老道的高階水肺潛水員在澎湖七美海域順著強勁洋流前進，享受御風而行般的「放流潛水」。

examples.en: Always deploy an orange surface marker buoy before ascending in an unpredictable tidal current.
examples.zh: 在變幻莫測的潮汐強流中準備上升水面時，第一件事務必先打起顯眼亮橘色的水面浮標（SMB）。

examples.en: Rip currents can pull unwary swimmers away from the beach at speeds surpassing Olympic athletes.
examples.zh: 海邊無聲無息的離岸流（裂流）能在數秒內將戲水遊客迅速拖往外海，其流速甚至超越奧運游泳健將。

words.definition: 黑潮暖流 (太平洋最大暖流)

examples.en: The mighty Kuroshio Current carries warm tropical waters and migratory tuna northward along Taiwan's east coast.
examples.zh: 磅礡奔騰的黑潮暖流沿著台灣東海岸北上，為沿岸帶來溫暖水溫與豐富洄游黑鮪魚及旗魚漁汛。

examples.en: Marine biologists track whale migrations using acoustic hydrophones anchored along the Kuroshio channel.
examples.zh: 海洋生物研究團隊在黑潮主流深水水域錨泊水下水聽器陣列，長年追蹤大型鬚鯨與抹香鯨的遷徙歌聲。

examples.en: The fast-flowing Kuroshio represents a monumental renewable kinetic resource for deep ocean turbine generation.
examples.zh: 日夜滾滾奔騰的深海黑潮蘊藏著浩瀚無窮的天然水流動能，是台灣發展深海黑潮渦輪發電的無價瑰寶。

words.definition: 海洋生態保護區；庇護所

examples.en: Establishing marine sanctuaries creates no-take replenishment zones that replenish dwindling fish stocks.
examples.zh: 劃設禁漁海洋生態保護區能建立天然繁衍庇護所，讓瀕危魚種在此安心產卵並充實周邊漁場資源。

examples.en: The island established a coral reef sanctuary where anchoring and motorized watercraft are banned.
examples.zh: 這座美麗小島劃定了國家級珊瑚礁保護區，區內全面嚴禁各類船隻下錨與水上摩托車競速。

examples.en: Patrol boats guard the borders of the marine sanctuary to deter poachers from setting illegal gillnets.
examples.zh: 動員巡邏艇日夜嚴密在海洋生態保護區周遭警戒巡防，強力嚇阻不肖違法漁民摸黑前來盜撒三層流刺網。

words.definition: 過度捕撈枯竭；濫捕

examples.en: Commercial overfishing threatens ocean ecosystem stability and destroys predatory pelagic species.
examples.zh: 工業化大型拖網漁船的長期過度捕撈嚴重摧毀了海洋生態金字塔，導致頂級掠食性魚類急遽銳減。

examples.en: Implementing strict seasonal fishing quotas is necessary to reverse decades of chronic overfishing.
examples.zh: 依法嚴格制定並執行禁漁期與捕撈配額制度，是挽救過去數十年來海洋資源慢性過度枯竭的必行之舉。

examples.en: Consumer seafood guides help shoppers choose sustainably caught species instead of victims of overfishing.
examples.zh: 推廣永續海鮮消費採購指南，能引導大眾優先挑選產量穩定的底層海鮮，拒吃面臨過度捕撈的瀕危魚種。

words.definition: 海洋廢棄物；殘骸垃圾 (Marine Debris)

examples.en: Volunteer divers haul tons of discarded fishing nets and plastic marine debris from the seafloor.
examples.zh: 熱血潛水志工每週背著氣瓶潛入海底，合力割除並打撈重達數噸的沉底廢棄刺網與海洋塑膠垃圾。

examples.en: Ingested microplastic debris accumulates inside the digestive systems of seabirds and marine mammals.
examples.zh: 漂浮在海中的微塑膠碎片被誤食後，會長期沉積累積在海鳥與海洋哺乳動物的腸胃消化系統中。

examples.en: Giant ocean gyres trap floating plastic debris, forming massive offshore garbage patches across the Pacific.
examples.zh: 浩瀚的太平洋環流系統將數以億計的漂流塑膠廢棄物聚攏在一起，形成了震驚全球的「太平洋垃圾帶」。

words.definition: 淨灘活動；淨海行動；清理

examples.en: Thousands of citizens joined the coastal beach cleanup, collecting three tons of PET bottles in a single day.
examples.zh: 數千名熱心民眾踴躍報名參加全台海岸淨灘行動，在短短一天內齊心協力清除了三噸海漂寶特瓶。

examples.en: The university diving club organized an underwater harbor cleanup to remove rusted batteries and tires.
examples.zh: 大學潛水社團主動發起港灣海底水下淨海行動，合力打撈清運出大量長年沉積的生鏽廢電池與廢輪胎。

examples.en: Recording the types of collected trash during each beach cleanup helps policymakers track pollution sources.
examples.zh: 在每次淨灘行動中落實國際淨灘 ICC 垃圾分類統計建檔，能提供環保主管機關第一手精確的污染源追溯。

words.definition: 智慧水產養殖；水產科技

examples.en: High-tech offshore cage aquaculture withstands typhoon swells while cultivating premium grouper.
examples.zh: 澎湖外海引進的抗颱沈水式圓形深海箱網智慧水產養殖系統，能穩定培育頂級無毒龍膽石斑與海鱺。

examples.en: Recirculating land-based aquaculture systems recycle 95% of water through multi-stage bio-filtration.
examples.zh: 現代化陸上封閉式循環水養殖系統（RAS），透過多道精密生物濾槽淨化，達到循環再利用九成五以上的水源。

examples.en: Sustainable seaweed aquaculture sequesters dissolved nitrogen while creating nutritious food ingredients.
examples.zh: 大力推動永續大型海藻與裙帶菜人工水產養殖，能在吸收海水中多餘溶解氮磷的同時供應營養膳食食材。

words.definition: 龍膽石斑魚；石斑魚

examples.en: Taiwan is internationally acclaimed as the grouper breeding kingdom, pioneering giant grouper fry techniques.
examples.zh: 台灣被國際譽為「石斑魚王國」，在龍膽石斑人工繁殖育苗與無用藥養殖技術上享譽全球。

examples.en: Steamed giant grouper fillets garnished with scallions and ginger are a beloved banquet delicacy.
examples.zh: 鋪滿青蔥絲與老薑絲的原汁清蒸頂級龍膽石斑魚片，是各大飯店婚宴辦桌上最受歡迎的尊貴大菜。

examples.en: Healthy groupers lurk motionlessly under coral overhangs before ambushing passing crabs with lightning speed.
examples.zh: 棲息於天然礁岩洞穴中的健康石斑魚平日靜止不動伏臥，一旦獵物螃蟹經過便以迅雷不及掩耳之勢突襲吞食。

words.definition: 深海海底；洋底 (Seafloor)

examples.en: Deep-sea trench exploration revealed fascinating volcanic hydrothermal vent ecosystems on the seabed.
examples.zh: 深海潛水器深入數千公尺的海底火山熱泉噴口探勘，揭示了完全無需陽光的奇異海底熱液生態系。

examples.en: Seismic monitoring sensors anchored to the seabed detect underwater earthquake tremors within seconds.
examples.zh: 牢固錨定在台灣周邊萬米深海海底的地震監測感測儀，能在海溝強震爆發的數秒內即時回傳預警信號。

examples.en: Mining valuable rare earth nodules from the abyssal seabed poses unpredictable environmental hazards.
examples.zh: 貿然向數千公尺深海深洋底層開採極具經濟價值的稀土錳結核礦石，將帶來不可逆的深海環境浩劫。

words.definition: 海底光纖光學的；光學的

examples.en: Transpacific subsea optical fiber cables transmit 99% of international cloud internet data.
examples.zh: 橫跨太平洋底的超高速海底光纖電纜，乘載了全台灣百分之九十九以上的國際網際網路雲端數據傳輸。

examples.en: Robotic submersibles inspect the protective armored jackets of subsea optical communications lines.
examples.zh: 無人深海潛水載具沿著海底光纜鋪設路徑巡弋，定期仔細檢測光纜外層防鯊鋼鎧甲是否遭受磨損。

examples.en: Laying high-bandwidth optical cables between remote islands guarantees uninterrupted medical teleconsulting.
examples.zh: 在偏遠離島與本島間鋪設雙迴路高頻寬海底光纖電纜，能確保離島居民享有零延遲的遠距智慧醫療會診。

words.definition: 水下的；海底的 (Subsea)

examples.en: Subsea engineering teams deploy robotic crawlers to bury high-voltage cables beneath the seafloor.
examples.zh: 水下工程團隊出動重型水下載具履帶車，將離線風場特高壓電纜安全深埋於海底沙層下方。

examples.en: Specialized diving chambers allow deep technicians to conduct subsea pipeline hyperbaric welding safely.
examples.zh: 特製的深海高壓作業潛水鐘，能讓深水專業工程潛水員在海底油氣管線旁安全進行高壓乾式焊接修復。

examples.en: Continuous subsea surveillance systems monitor the physical integrity of offshore energy infrastructure.
examples.zh: 全天候運作的水下主被動聲納監控系統，隨時守護著離岸風電與海纜等重大關鍵基礎設施的實體安全。

words.definition: 遠端遙控地；偏遠地

examples.en: Remotely Operated Vehicles (ROVs) equipped with robotic arms retrieve geological core samples from depths.
examples.zh: 配備精密多軸機械手臂的水下無人遙控潛水器（ROV），能深入數千米深海精準抓取地質岩心樣本。

examples.en: Offshore engineers can monitor and control substation turbines remotely from onshore control rooms.
examples.zh: 離岸風電工程師坐在陸地中央監控中心的螢幕前，即可跨海全天候遠端遙控數十公里外的變電站與風機。

examples.en: Exploring volcanic chimneys remotely protects human oceanographers from scalding acidic fluids.
examples.zh: 透過無人水下載具進行遠端熱泉探勘，能讓海洋學家免於暴露在深海數百度滾燙酸性高壓熱液的極度危險中。

words.definition: 水下聲納探測系統；聲波定位

examples.en: Multibeam sonar bathymetry maps high-resolution 3D contours of undersea volcanoes and canyons.
examples.zh: 搭載多音束水下聲納測深儀的研究船，能以高解析度 3D 立體建模完整重現海底火山與大峽谷地形。

examples.en: Navy ships utilize passive listening sonar to detect the distant propeller signatures of submarines.
examples.zh: 海軍現代化反潛驅逐艦運用被動水下監聽聲納陣列，在數十海浬外精準辨識潛艦螺旋槳的特有音頻噪聲。

examples.en: Fishermen monitor fish-finding sonar screens to locate schooling pelagic mackerel below their hull.
examples.zh: 近海漁船船長聚精會神緊盯駕駛台上的高頻彩色魚探聲納螢幕，掌握船底深處大群鯖魚的游動軌跡。

words.definition: 離岸風力渦輪機發電機；渦輪機

examples.en: Massive 14-megawatt offshore wind turbines harness howling Taiwan Strait breezes to generate clean power.
examples.zh: 矗立在彰化與苗栗外海重達數千噸的十四百萬瓦離岸風力渦輪發電機，將強勁海風轉化為潔淨電力。

examples.en: The rotating rotor blades of the wind turbine span a diameter wider than a commercial airliner's wingspan.
examples.zh: 現代離岸巨型風機的巨大旋轉葉片掃掠面積直徑，甚至超越了波音巨無霸民航客機的翼展寬度。

examples.en: Regular grease lubrication and gearbox inspections ensure that each offshore turbine runs continuously.
examples.zh: 嚴格定期指派海事工程師攀上百米高塔進行齒輪箱潤滑檢修，確保每一座離岸渦輪風機終年穩定旋轉。

words.definition: 水下套管式水下基礎；夾克外套

examples.en: Steel jacket foundations pinned with giant underwater piles support massive wind towers in typhoons.
examples.zh: 採用重型鋼結構四腳套管式水下基礎（Jacket）打入海床深處，能在強烈颱風中穩穩支撐百米風機。

examples.en: Fabricating a 2,000-tonne steel jacket requires precision welding standards certified by global maritime bureaus.
examples.zh: 在重工廠重件碼頭打造一座高達七十米、重達兩千噸的巨型套管水下基礎，需遵循最嚴苛的國際海事焊接規範。

examples.en: Marine engineers inspect the jacket legs with ultrasound scanners to verify weld structural integrity.
examples.zh: 海事檢驗工程師運用高階超音波探傷儀器仔細檢驗水下鋼構管件焊道，確認無任何肉眼看不見的應力裂縫。

words.definition: 大型重吊海事施工船；船隻；血管

examples.en: Heavy-lift installation vessels equipped with 4,000-tonne cranes position wind turbines offshore.
examples.zh: 搭載四千噸級巨型旋轉吊車的離岸海事重吊安裝船，頂著海浪在台灣海峽精準完成風力發電機組裝。

examples.en: The coast guard dispatched a cutter vessel to rescue stranded fishermen during the tropical gale.
examples.zh: 海巡署在強烈熱帶低壓狂風暴雨中火速派遣千噸級巡防艦艇馳援，成功救出在礁岩擱淺待援的落海釣客。

examples.en: Modern oceanographic research vessels feature dynamic positioning thrusters to hold coordinates in swells.
examples.zh: 現代化頂級綜合海洋研究船配備全方位動態定位推進器，即便在洶湧湧浪中亦能穩如泰山定位在定點。

words.definition: 海底高壓電力輸送；傳輸；變速箱

examples.en: Underground subsea power transmission cables feed offshore wind energy directly into national power grids.
examples.zh: 鋪設於海床底部的特高壓海底電力傳輸電纜，將外海綠能電力零損耗安全併入台灣本島國家電網。

examples.en: Minimizing electricity loss along high-voltage AC transmission lines requires sophisticated offshore substations.
examples.zh: 為了將外海風電長途傳輸的電能損耗降至最低，海事工程團隊在海中央興建了高規格離岸海上變電站。

examples.en: Fiber-optic cores embedded within the power transmission cable monitor internal temperature real-time.
examples.zh: 複合海底高壓電力電纜內部整合了高靈敏度通訊光纖芯線，能毫秒級動態監控全線電纜溫升與應變狀態。

words.definition: 水下噪音減緩防護；減輕緩和

examples.en: Double bubble curtains provide noise mitigation during pile-driving to protect marine mammals.
examples.zh: 離岸風電打樁時在周遭海域施放「雙層水下氣泡幕」進行噪音減緩防護，以降低對鯨豚聽力的干擾。

examples.en: Environmental regulations mandate strict acoustic mitigation protocols whenever seismic surveys occur.
examples.zh: 國家海事環評法規嚴格規定在海域進行震波地質測勘時，必須採取嚴格的水下聲學噪音減緩防護措施。

examples.en: Effective flood mitigation infrastructure along coastal lowlands saves village homes from tidal surges.
examples.zh: 沿著低窪濱海鄉村興建的防洪閘門與大型自動抽水站等減災工程，能有效抵禦大潮與暴潮引發的倒灌淹水。

words.definition: 白海豚（台灣媽祖魚）；海豚

examples.en: The critically endangered Taiwanese white dolphin population requires strict habitat conservation corridors.
examples.zh: 數量極為稀少瀕危的台灣特有亞種中華白海豚（媽祖魚），極度需要設立專屬棲地生態保育廊道。

examples.en: Tourists rejoiced as a pod of playful dolphins leapt synchronously out of the turquoise waves.
examples.zh: 當成群活潑結伴同行的野生海豚整齊劃一跳出湛藍碧綠的波浪時，賞鯨船上的遊客無不發出陣陣驚呼喝采。

examples.en: Acoustic monitoring networks detect dolphin clicks to alert nearby commercial ships to slow down.
examples.zh: 水下被動聲學監測系統一旦偵測到海豚發出的回聲定位高頻點擊聲，便會即刻警示周圍大型商船減速航行。

words.definition: 飛旋海豚（空中旋轉躍起）；紡紗者

examples.en: Pods of agile spinner dolphins leap and spin three times in the air alongside tour boats.
examples.zh: 在花蓮外海成群結隊的飛旋海豚活潑伴隨賞鯨船乘浪前進，在空中連續旋轉三圈半躍出水面。

examples.en: Observing spinner dolphins performing acrobatic aerial corkscrews is a magical hallmark of eastern Taiwan.
examples.zh: 親眼目睹成群野生飛旋海豚在空中上演宛如芭蕾舞般優美的高難度縱軸旋轉，是台灣東海岸最震撼的生態奇蹟。

examples.en: The spinner dolphin feeds on small lanternfish in deep open waters during pitch-black nights.
examples.zh: 習性獨特的飛旋海豚每當夜幕低垂漆黑之際，便會聯手潛入大洋深層合力獵食垂直洄游的小型發光燈籠魚。

words.definition: 海洋潮汐漲落；潮水；趨勢

examples.en: The gravitational pull of the moon creates predictable rhythmic high and low ocean tides.
examples.zh: 月球與太陽對地球的萬有引力在浩瀚大洋中引發了每日規律起伏、漲退有序的潮汐更替現象。

examples.en: Fishermen consult local tide tables before venturing onto dangerous intertidal rock platforms.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的近海漁民與採蚵人家，在出發前往危險的礁岩海蝕平台前，必定會仔細核對當日潮汐時刻表。

examples.en: The receding evening tide exposed hundreds of hidden tide pools brimming with colorful marine critters.
examples.zh: 傍晚緩緩退去的海潮，在廣闊平坦的礁石間裸露出數百個生機盎然、藏著各色微小海洋生物的天然潮池。

words.definition: 潮間帶生態的；潮間帶的

examples.en: Ecologists lead children on night walks through the rich intertidal zone to discover nocturnal crabs.
examples.zh: 生態專家帶領學童在退潮夜間走入生機盎然的潮間帶，打著手電筒尋找夜行性饅頭蟹與海兔。

examples.en: Organisms residing in the intertidal zone must withstand scorching midday sun and crushing tidal wave action.
examples.zh: 生活在潮間帶極端環境中的藤壺、笠螺與海藻，必須天生具備抗高溫日曬與狂暴碎浪拍擊的頑強生命力。

examples.en: Coastal development must tread carefully to prevent permanent destruction of fragile intertidal ecosystems.
examples.zh: 濱海公路興建與遊憩港灣開發必須經過周詳環評，以全力避免對極其脆弱珍貴的潮間帶生態造成毀滅性破壞。

words.definition: 潮間帶天然潮池；水池；匯集

examples.en: Clear tidal rock pools act as natural aquariums teeming with juvenile fish, anemones, and hermit crabs.
examples.zh: 退潮後留在礁岩凹陷處的天然潮池宛如一座座露天水族箱，生氣勃勃擠滿了小幼魚、海葵與寄居蟹。

examples.en: Children crouched beside the calm rock pool to marvel at a translucent glass shrimp darting through seaweed.
examples.zh: 孩童們興奮地蹲在風平浪靜的岩礁潮池邊，聚精會神觀察一隻晶瑩剔透的小玻璃蝦在翠綠海石蓴間敏捷穿梭。

examples.en: Never disturb stones inside a fragile tide pool, as they shelter shy octopuses and sea urchins.
examples.zh: 走訪天然潮池時請隨手將翻動的石頭歸位，因為每一塊岩石底層都可能是害羞章魚與海膽賴以安居的避難所。

words.definition: 珍貴濱海濕地；沼澤地

examples.en: Taichung's Gaomei Wetlands feature vast mudflats, wind turbines, and breathtaking golden sunsets.
examples.zh: 台中高美濕地以遼闊平坦的泥灘地、轉動的白色風車群與落日熔金的壯麗夕陽絕景聞名國內外。

examples.en: Preserving natural wetland habitats provides critical migratory layover feeding grounds for thousands of birds.
examples.zh: 悉心守護濱海天然濕地棲地環境，能為每年南遷度冬的成千上萬珍稀候鳥提供無可取代的中途覓食補給站。

examples.en: The newly opened educational boardwalk allows tourists to observe wetland biodiversity without treading on mud.
examples.zh: 全新鋪設架高延伸入海的生態木棧道，讓絡繹不絕的旅人能夠近距離欣賞濕地萬千生機，同時不踩踏破壞泥灘。

words.definition: 紅樹林水筆仔；紅樹植物

examples.en: Mangrove forests in the Tamsui River estuary anchor coastlines and shelter juvenile fish nurseries.
examples.zh: 淡水河口八里與紅樹林保留區茂密的水筆仔紅樹林，能鞏固海岸河堤並成為魚蝦幼苗茁壯的溫床。

examples.en: The specialized aerial stilt roots of mangrove trees absorb vital oxygen even when submerged at high tide.
examples.zh: 水筆仔紅樹林特化演變出的粗壯水筆仔氣生根與支持根，即便在滿潮全被海水淹沒時也能順暢呼吸氧氣。

examples.en: Kayaking through winding mangrove channels offers a serene way to observe roosting egrets up close.
examples.zh: 划著無動力的環保獨木舟緩緩穿梭於蜿蜒幽靜的紅樹林綠色水上隧道，能近距離欣賞在枝頭棲息的純白白鷺鷥。

words.definition: 招潮蟹（公蟹持巨螯）；小提琴手

examples.en: Male fiddler crabs wave their oversized golden claws rhythmically to attract mates across mudflats.
examples.zh: 泥灘地上的雄性招潮蟹高高舉起巨大如小提琴般的鮮黃色大螯有節奏地揮舞，熱情求偶宣示地盤。

examples.en: When high tide rolls in, the cautious fiddler crab seals its burrow entrance with a neat plug of wet mud.
examples.zh: 每當海水開始漲潮浪花湧來之際，警覺性極高的招潮蟹便會以濕潤泥巴搓成小泥球，嚴絲合縫封住洞口避難。

examples.en: Hundreds of tiny fiddler crabs emerge simultaneously to sift nutrient-rich algae out of the shoreline mud.
examples.zh: 成百上千隻嬌小的招潮蟹在退潮後同時自泥洞探頭爬出，以小巧的刮食螯在泥灘表面高效率濾食微細藻類。

words.definition: 海水淡化造水廠；脫鹽作用

examples.en: Seawater reverse osmosis desalination plants supply pure drinking water to offshore Penghu islands.
examples.zh: 澎湖與金馬離島全面興建現代化逆滲透海水淡化廠，將取之不盡的海水轉化為甘甜純淨的民生自來水。

examples.en: Powered by solar arrays, modern desalination plants achieve exceptional energy efficiency with zero emissions.
examples.zh: 結合屋頂型太陽能綠電發電系統，現代化海水淡化廠實現了低碳排、高能效的綠色造水新標竿。

examples.en: The municipal water bureau invested in large-scale seawater desalination to combat climate change droughts.
examples.zh: 地方自來水事業單位投入巨資打造大型萬噸級海水淡化廠，為極端氣候下日益頻繁的百年大旱未雨綢繆。

words.definition: 海巡署海事巡邏巡弋；巡邏

examples.en: Coast Guard cutters patrol national maritime borders 24/7 to deter illegal poaching and smuggling.
examples.zh: 海洋委員會海巡署千噸級巡防艦全天候巡弋守護國家領海經濟海域，嚴格取締越界捕魚與海上走私。

examples.en: Marine wildlife protection units patrol fragile turtle nesting beaches every single night during summer.
examples.zh: 海洋野生動物保護保育巡守員每逢盛夏產卵季，整夜寸步不離守護著小海龜孵化的脆弱沙灘。

examples.en: Aerial drones assist the maritime police patrol in tracking suspicious vessels maneuvering without identification flags.
examples.zh: 遠程空中監控無人機高空巡弋，強大協同海巡巡防艇精準追緝在海面關閉船舶自動辨識系統的幽靈可疑私梟。

words.definition: 導航燈塔（如鵝鑾鼻燈塔）

examples.en: The historic Eluanbi Lighthouse has beamed navigational light across the Bashi Channel for 140 years.
examples.zh: 矗立在台灣最南端的鵝鑾鼻燈塔一百四十年來日夜旋轉發光，在巴士海峽為往來各國船隻指引航向。

examples.en: Mariners caught in nighttime sea fogs rely on the lighthouse's rhythmic optical flash to chart safety.
examples.zh: 在伸手不見五指的深夜濃霧中航行的各國船員，全憑燈塔規律旋轉的高流明閃爍光束校正航線、平安返航。

examples.en: Perched atop the dramatic windswept cliff, the stark white lighthouse attracts photography enthusiasts year-round.
examples.zh: 雄踞在海風呼嘯的懸崖峭壁之巔，純白聖潔的東引燈塔一年四季吸引著全台無數攝影愛好者前來朝聖取景。

words.definition: 深邃海溝深淵；無底深淵

examples.en: Bioluminescent glowing creatures illuminate the pitch-black abyss five thousand meters deep.
examples.zh: 在深達五千公尺完全無光的幽暗海溝深淵中，自體發光的深海奇特生物點綴出夢幻般的點點星光。

examples.en: Research submersibles dive into the Mariana abyss, enduring pressures exceeding one thousand atmospheres.
examples.zh: 特製的鈦合金深海潛水載具緩緩探入馬里亞納海溝最深處的無底深淵，硬扛承受超過一千個大氣壓的駭人水壓。

examples.en: The vast and mysterious ocean abyss holds undiscovered marine medicines that could benefit future generations.
examples.zh: 浩瀚而神秘的深海大洋深淵底部，極可能蘊藏著尚未被人類發現、未來能治癒重症疾病的天然生物活性醫藥分子。

words.definition: 無垠浩瀚的；無限的

examples.en: Standing before the boundless Pacific Ocean fills our hearts with humility, awe, and endless dreams.
examples.zh: 佇立在浩瀚無垠的太平洋海岸邊，迎著海風，內心充滿對大自然的謙卑、敬畏與無限遠大的夢想。

examples.en: The boundless resilience of marine life reminds us of nature's miraculous capacity to heal when protected.
examples.zh: 海洋生靈展現出無垠廣大的生命韌性，深刻啟示著我們：只要人類給予妥善守護，大自然便擁有奇蹟般的自癒力。

examples.en: Gazing at the boundless star-studded horizon from the deck of a sailboat brings profound inner quietude.
examples.zh: 深夜站在帆船甲板上放眼望去，凝望浩瀚無垠且繁星點點的海平線，內心湧現出無比深邃純粹的安詳平靜。
